create_edict_pipeline: create an EDICTPipeline instance with vae, text_encoder, tokenizer, unet, and scheduler components
run_edict_image_editing: run the EDICTPipeline __call__ method to transform an image from a base prompt to a target prompt
encode_text_prompts: encode text prompts into embeddings using the EDICTPipeline _encode_prompt method with optional negative prompts
prepare_latent_inputs: prepare coupled latent inputs from an image and text embeddings through the EDICTPipeline prepare_latents method
decode_latent_tensors: decode latent tensors back into images using the EDICTPipeline decode_latents method
